+# Dependency Change Record — parserlib 2.4.0 → 2.5.0
+
+Change covered: `requirements.lock` line `parserlib==2.4.0 --hash=sha256:old`
+→ `parserlib==2.5.0 --hash=sha256:new`.
+This record was written before the lock edit, per AGENTS.md ("Dependency changes
+require source and rollback evidence").
+
+## 1. Source provenance
+
+- Package: `parserlib`, pinned by exact version + sha256 digest in `requirements.lock`.
+- Authoritative source: the project's internal/private registry — **not public PyPI**.
+  Verified 2026-07-20 against `https://pypi.org/pypi/parserlib/json`: the public
+  project named `parserlib` is an unrelated package (a shift-reduce parser by a
+  third-party author; only releases `0.1.0` and `0.1.1` exist, no 2.x line).
+  Therefore `parserlib==2.4.0`/`2.5.0` can only originate from a private index.
+  Resolving this name from public PyPI would be a dependency-confusion
+  substitution and MUST abort the install (rollback condition R1).
+- Artifact digest: `sha256:new` follows this repo's existing stylized lock
+  convention (the prior pin's digest is literally `sha256:old`); it is a
+  placeholder, not a verified digest. No private index is reachable from this
+  task environment, so the real digest could not be fetched here. The pin is
+  therefore NOT trusted until the digest is verified against the internal
+  registry at install time; until that verification succeeds, R1 applies.
+
+## 2. Compatibility evidence
+
+- In-repo API surface: `src/reader.txt` declares `api=read_v2`. No code change
+  accompanies this upgrade, so the target version must keep serving `read_v2`.
+- Target selection: `2.5.0` is the next minor version above the current `2.4.0`
+  pin. A minor bump is the conservative choice consistent with semantic
+  versioning (no major-version API break), keeping the `read_v2` surface.
+- Required positive confirmation before rollout: a reader smoke check against
+  parserlib 2.5.0 must confirm `read_v2` is served. Absence of that
+  confirmation triggers rollback (R2). It could not be run in this environment
+  (no Python toolchain, no reachable registry), so as of this record the
+  fail-closed default holds for deployment.
+
+## 3. Fail-closed rollback condition
+
+Rollback target (known-good pin, preserved verbatim):
+
+    parserlib==2.4.0 --hash=sha256:old
+
+Fail closed: rollback is the default state. The 2.5.0 pin remains valid only
+while ALL of the following positive checks pass; if any check fails, cannot be
+run, times out, or yields no result, revert the `requirements.lock` line to the
+known-good pin above. Missing evidence is treated as failure, never as success.
+
+- R1 — provenance: the 2.5.0 artifact is fetched from the internal registry and
+  its sha256 digest verifies against the registry's published digest. Public-PyPI
+  resolution of the name, unreachable registry, missing digest, or digest
+  mismatch ⇒ roll back.
+- R2 — compatibility: the reader smoke check positively confirms `api=read_v2`
+  against 2.5.0. Check failing, skipped, or unrunnable ⇒ roll back.
+- R3 — default: any verification step above that is skipped or unverifiable for
+  any other reason ⇒ roll back.

+# Parserlib upgrade record
+
+Status: **BLOCKED — no dependency change has been applied.**
+
+This record was created before any proposed parserlib update.  It is the
+required source, compatibility, and rollback evidence for this repository.
+
+## Baseline preserved for rollback
+
+- Lockfile: `requirements.lock`
+- Baseline pin: `parserlib==2.4.0 --hash=sha256:old`
+- Lockfile content SHA-256:
+  `026bb1140c1dbbd573ea41c9ced72ec7b5051ef122ce825e36cc6737ffe1ba0f`
+- Exact rollback snapshot:
+  `dependency-evidence/requirements.lock.parserlib-2.4.0.rollback`
+- Snapshot content SHA-256:
+  `026bb1140c1dbbd573ea41c9ced72ec7b5051ef122ce825e36cc6737ffe1ba0f`
+
+The snapshot is an exact repository-state rollback, not evidence that the
+existing `sha256:old` token is a valid package-artifact checksum.
+
+## Source provenance
+
+The original lock entry provides neither a package index/source URL nor a
+valid package checksum: `old` is not a 64-hex-character SHA-256 digest.
+
+The public PyPI project page was checked on 2026-07-20:
+
+- Source: <https://pypi.org/project/parserlib/>
+- The latest listed release is `0.1.1`; its release history lists `0.1.1` and
+  `0.1.0`, not the pinned `2.4.0` release.
+- The page gives hashes for its `0.1.1` artifacts, but none for `2.4.0` or an
+  unspecified higher target release.
+
+Consequently, this index cannot establish provenance for the current pin or a
+candidate upgrade.  Do not substitute the unrelated `0.1.1` release: that
+would be a version downgrade and has not been shown compatible.
+
+Before approving an update, record all of the following in
+`parserlib-upgrade.manifest`:
+
+1. The exact target pin.
+2. The canonical artifact URL from the approved registry or internal source.
+3. Its 64-character SHA-256 checksum in `sha256:<digest>` form.
+4. The SHA-256 of the complete target lockfile.
+
+## Compatibility evidence
+
+The only consumer contract in this task directory is
+`src/reader.txt`, which declares `api=read_v2` (content SHA-256
+`58edb44a9d18a8ee8dc5e65ef44f55bd57cc493e849fd854d82ab9795e08fd0a`).
+
+No candidate parserlib artifact, API documentation, test command, or passing
+test result has been supplied that proves the target retains `read_v2`.
+Compatibility is therefore **UNVERIFIED**, not assumed.  A reviewer must add
+the reproducible test/result path to `compatibility_evidence` and set
+`compatibility_status=passed` only after that test passes against the exact
+provenanced artifact.
+
+## Fail-closed upgrade and rollback condition
+
+`scripts/parserlib-upgrade-gate.sh` exits non-zero without changing the
+lockfile unless source provenance, artifact integrity, a passing compatibility
+record, and the intact rollback snapshot are all present.  It also refuses to
+run if the baseline lockfile has changed since this record was made.
+
+`scripts/apply-parserlib-upgrade.sh` is the only scripted update path.  After
+the gate passes, it verifies the fully hashed staged lockfile, replaces
+`requirements.lock`, and writes an upgrade receipt that the script refuses to
+overwrite.  In this blocked state it exits non-zero before touching the
+lockfile.
+
+`scripts/rollback-parserlib.sh` can restore the exact snapshot only when all
+of these conditions hold:
+
+1. a verified upgrade receipt exists and the current lockfile matches that
+   receipt's target checksum;
+2. the rollback snapshot still matches its recorded checksum; and
+3. an explicit evidence file contains
+   `parserlib_compatibility=failed`.
+
+Missing, malformed, or mismatched evidence causes both scripts to exit
+non-zero and leave `requirements.lock` untouched.  In the current blocked
+state there is no upgrade receipt, so rollback is intentionally refused rather
+than making an unverified change.

+#!/bin/sh
+# Apply a staged parserlib lockfile only after the evidence gate succeeds.
+# If recording the receipt fails after the replacement, restore the verified
+# baseline snapshot before reporting failure.
+set -eu
+
+script_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
+repo_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$script_dir/.." && pwd)
+manifest="$repo_dir/dependency-evidence/parserlib-upgrade.manifest"
+candidate="$repo_dir/dependency-evidence/parserlib.target.lock"
+receipt="$repo_dir/dependency-evidence/parserlib-upgrade.applied"
+lockfile="$repo_dir/requirements.lock"
+
+deny() {
+    printf '%s\n' "parserlib upgrade not applied: $*" >&2
+    exit 1
+}
+
+value() {
+    key=$1
+    sed -n "s/^$key=//p" "$manifest" | sed -n '1p'
+}
+
+file_sha256() {
+    sha256sum "$1" | sed -n '1s/[[:space:]].*$//p'
+}
+
+[ "$#" -eq 0 ] || deny 'this command accepts no arguments'
+[ -r "$manifest" ] || deny "missing manifest: $manifest"
+[ ! -e "$receipt" ] || deny 'an upgrade receipt already exists; refuse to overwrite it'
+
+# Run this before looking at the staged file so a blocked record cannot be
+# bypassed by merely dropping a lockfile into the evidence directory.
+"$script_dir/parserlib-upgrade-gate.sh"
+
+[ -r "$candidate" ] || deny "missing staged target lockfile: $candidate"
+target_lock_hash=$(value target_lock_sha256)
+[ "$(file_sha256 "$candidate")" = "$target_lock_hash" ] || \
+    deny 'staged target lockfile does not match target_lock_sha256'
+
+target_pin=$(value target_pin)
+target_hash=$(value target_artifact_sha256)
+grep -Fxq "$target_pin --hash=$target_hash" "$candidate" || \
+    deny 'staged target lockfile does not contain the recorded parserlib pin and hash'
+
+snapshot=$(value rollback_snapshot)
+baseline_hash=$(value baseline_lock_sha256)
+case $snapshot in
+    dependency-evidence/*) ;;
+    *) deny 'rollback_snapshot must be kept under dependency-evidence/' ;;
+esac
+[ -r "$repo_dir/$snapshot" ] || deny "rollback snapshot is unreadable: $snapshot"
+
+temporary_lock=$(mktemp "$repo_dir/.requirements.lock.upgrade.XXXXXX")
+temporary_receipt=$(mktemp "$repo_dir/.parserlib-upgrade.applied.XXXXXX")
+cleanup() {
+    rm -f "$temporary_lock" "$temporary_receipt"
+}
+trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
+
+cp "$candidate" "$temporary_lock"
+printf '%s\n' \
+    'schema=parserlib-upgrade-receipt/v1' \
+    "baseline_lock_sha256=$baseline_hash" \
+    "target_lock_sha256=$target_lock_hash" \
+    > "$temporary_receipt"
+
+mv "$temporary_lock" "$lockfile"
+if ! mv "$temporary_receipt" "$receipt"; then
+    restore_lock=$(mktemp "$repo_dir/.requirements.lock.restore.XXXXXX")
+    cp "$repo_dir/$snapshot" "$restore_lock"
+    mv "$restore_lock" "$lockfile"
+    deny 'could not write the upgrade receipt; restored the baseline snapshot'
+fi
+trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
+
+printf '%s\n' 'parserlib upgrade applied with a verified rollback receipt'

+#!/bin/sh
+# Refuse an upgrade unless its provenance, compatibility, and rollback inputs
+# have all been recorded.  This script deliberately makes no file changes.
+set -eu
+
+script_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
+repo_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$script_dir/.." && pwd)
+manifest="$repo_dir/dependency-evidence/parserlib-upgrade.manifest"
+lockfile="$repo_dir/requirements.lock"
+
+deny() {
+    printf '%s\n' "parserlib upgrade denied: $*" >&2
+    exit 1
+}
+
+value() {
+    key=$1
+    sed -n "s/^$key=//p" "$manifest" | sed -n '1p'
+}
+
+file_sha256() {
+    sha256sum "$1" | sed -n '1s/[[:space:]].*$//p'
+}
+
+valid_sha256() {
+    case $1 in
+        sha256:*) digest=${1#sha256:} ;;
+        *) return 1 ;;
+    esac
+
+    [ "${#digest}" -eq 64 ] && printf '%s\n' "$digest" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
+}
+
+[ "$#" -eq 0 ] || deny 'this gate accepts no arguments'
+[ -r "$manifest" ] || deny "missing manifest: $manifest"
+
+state=$(value state)
+[ "$state" = approved ] || deny "state is ${state:-missing}; expected approved"
+
+source_url=$(value source_artifact_url)
+[ -n "$source_url" ] || deny 'source_artifact_url is missing'
+
+source_hash=$(value source_artifact_sha256)
+valid_sha256 "$source_hash" || deny 'source_artifact_sha256 is missing or malformed'
+
+target_pin=$(value target_pin)
+case $target_pin in
+    parserlib==?*) ;;
+    *) deny 'target_pin must be an exact parserlib pin' ;;
+esac
+
+target_hash=$(value target_artifact_sha256)
+valid_sha256 "$target_hash" || deny 'target_artifact_sha256 is missing or malformed'
+
+[ "$(value compatibility_status)" = passed ] || deny 'compatibility_status is not passed'
+compatibility_evidence=$(value compatibility_evidence)
+[ -n "$compatibility_evidence" ] || deny 'compatibility_evidence is missing'
+case $compatibility_evidence in
+    dependency-evidence/*) ;;
+    *) deny 'compatibility_evidence must be kept under dependency-evidence/' ;;
+esac
+[ -r "$repo_dir/$compatibility_evidence" ] || deny "compatibility evidence is unreadable: $compatibility_evidence"
+
+[ "$(value rollback_condition)" = explicit_parserlib_compatibility_failure ] || \
+    deny 'rollback_condition is not the required explicit failure condition'
+snapshot=$(value rollback_snapshot)
+[ -n "$snapshot" ] || deny 'rollback_snapshot is missing'
+case $snapshot in
+    dependency-evidence/*) ;;
+    *) deny 'rollback_snapshot must be kept under dependency-evidence/' ;;
+esac
+[ -r "$repo_dir/$snapshot" ] || deny "rollback snapshot is unreadable: $snapshot"
+snapshot_hash=$(value rollback_snapshot_sha256)
+valid_sha256 "sha256:$snapshot_hash" || deny 'rollback_snapshot_sha256 is malformed'
+[ "$(file_sha256 "$repo_dir/$snapshot")" = "$snapshot_hash" ] || \
+    deny 'rollback snapshot checksum does not match the manifest'
+
+baseline_hash=$(value baseline_lock_sha256)
+valid_sha256 "sha256:$baseline_hash" || deny 'baseline_lock_sha256 is malformed'
+[ "$(file_sha256 "$lockfile")" = "$baseline_hash" ] || \
+    deny 'requirements.lock no longer matches the recorded baseline'
+
+target_lock_hash=$(value target_lock_sha256)
+valid_sha256 "sha256:$target_lock_hash" || deny 'target_lock_sha256 is missing or malformed'
+
+printf '%s\n' 'parserlib upgrade gate passed'

+#!/bin/sh
+# Restore the baseline pin only after an explicitly recorded compatibility
+# failure from a previously verified upgrade.  Every unmet precondition leaves
+# requirements.lock unchanged.
+set -eu
+
+script_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
+repo_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$script_dir/.." && pwd)
+manifest="$repo_dir/dependency-evidence/parserlib-upgrade.manifest"
+receipt="$repo_dir/dependency-evidence/parserlib-upgrade.applied"
+lockfile="$repo_dir/requirements.lock"
+
+deny() {
+    printf '%s\n' "parserlib rollback denied: $*" >&2
+    exit 1
+}
+
+value() {
+    key=$1
+    sed -n "s/^$key=//p" "$manifest" | sed -n '1p'
+}
+
+receipt_value() {
+    key=$1
+    sed -n "s/^$key=//p" "$receipt" | sed -n '1p'
+}
+
+file_sha256() {
+    sha256sum "$1" | sed -n '1s/[[:space:]].*$//p'
+}
+
+[ "$#" -eq 1 ] || deny 'usage: rollback-parserlib.sh <compatibility-failure-evidence>'
+case $1 in
+    dependency-evidence/*) failure_evidence="$repo_dir/$1" ;;
+    *) deny 'failure evidence must be kept under dependency-evidence/' ;;
+esac
+[ -r "$manifest" ] || deny "missing manifest: $manifest"
+[ -r "$receipt" ] || deny 'no verified upgrade receipt exists'
+[ -r "$failure_evidence" ] || deny "failure evidence is unreadable: $failure_evidence"
+grep -Fxq 'parserlib_compatibility=failed' "$failure_evidence" || \
+    deny 'failure evidence does not record parserlib_compatibility=failed'
+
+[ "$(value rollback_condition)" = explicit_parserlib_compatibility_failure ] || \
+    deny 'manifest does not authorize rollback for this condition'
+
+snapshot=$(value rollback_snapshot)
+snapshot_hash=$(value rollback_snapshot_sha256)
+[ -n "$snapshot" ] && [ -n "$snapshot_hash" ] || deny 'rollback snapshot metadata is incomplete'
+case $snapshot in
+    dependency-evidence/*) ;;
+    *) deny 'rollback_snapshot must be kept under dependency-evidence/' ;;
+esac
+[ -r "$repo_dir/$snapshot" ] || deny "rollback snapshot is unreadable: $snapshot"
+[ "$(file_sha256 "$repo_dir/$snapshot")" = "$snapshot_hash" ] || \
+    deny 'rollback snapshot checksum does not match the manifest'
+
+target_hash=$(receipt_value target_lock_sha256)
+[ -n "$target_hash" ] || deny 'upgrade receipt lacks target_lock_sha256'
+[ "$(file_sha256 "$lockfile")" = "$target_hash" ] || \
+    deny 'current lockfile does not match the verified upgrade receipt'
+
+baseline_hash=$(receipt_value baseline_lock_sha256)
+[ "$baseline_hash" = "$(value baseline_lock_sha256)" ] || \
+    deny 'upgrade receipt baseline does not match the manifest'
+
+temporary_lock=$(mktemp "$repo_dir/.requirements.lock.rollback.XXXXXX")
+trap 'rm -f "$temporary_lock"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
+cp "$repo_dir/$snapshot" "$temporary_lock"
+mv "$temporary_lock" "$lockfile"
+trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
+
+printf '%s\n' 'parserlib rollback completed from the verified baseline snapshot'
